rules.description: Birth must have occurred in England or Wales
rules.reason_if_failed: This service is for births in England and Wales only. Different rules apply for Scotland, Northern Ireland, and births abroad.

rules.description: Birth must be registered within 42 days
rules.reason_if_failed: Late registrations (after 42 days) require a different process. You may need to provide additional evidence and speak to a superintendent registrar.

rules.description: Person registering must be a qualified informant
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be a parent, someone present at the birth, someone responsible for the child, or hospital administrative staff to register the birth.

rules.description: Informant must provide at least one form of acceptable identification
rules.reason_if_failed: You must bring at least one form of identification (passport, birth certificate, deed poll, driving licence, proof of address, Council Tax bill, or marriage/civil partnership certificate).

rules.description: Informant must be able to provide required birth details
rules.reason_if_failed: You need to know the place and date of birth, baby's name and sex, and parents' details to complete the registration.

edge_cases.description: Same-sex male couples must obtain a parental order from the court before registration
edge_cases.action: Route to court services. You must apply for a parental order from the family court before you can be registered as parents.

edge_cases.description: Unmarried parents wanting both names on certificate need statutory declaration or joint registration
edge_cases.action: Explain options: (1) both parents attend together, (2) one parent brings signed statutory declaration from the other, (3) one parent brings court order giving father parental responsibility.

edge_cases.description: Births involving surrogacy may require parental order from court
edge_cases.action: Route to legal advice. Surrogacy arrangements may require a parental order from the court before registration.

edge_cases.description: Parents unable to register due to medical or other serious reasons
edge_cases.action: Confirm alternative qualified informant is present. Hospital staff or person present at birth may register instead.
Route to superintendent registrar. Late registrations require additional evidence and may incur penalties.

edge_cases.description: Birth occurred outside England and Wales
edge_cases.action: Route to appropriate service (Scotland, Northern Ireland, or overseas registration service).
